The notice board is read by facing it and pressing E. But I'm ON its tile. The board is at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7). This is the problem — I'm embedded. 

Wait — maybe the observe "You: Workshop (2,7)" is where I am, and the notice board is also listed at (2,7) because it's the nearest object but actually adjacent. Let me look at the raw map again — it showed '@' at (2,7) and no 'o' near. The 'o' objects were at (7,6) and (10,5). So the notice board isn't drawn as 'o' on the map at (2,7)!

So the map shows (2,7) as '@' walkable. Yet movement fails. Let me try the walk_to to a far tile and see the leg details.
